integrity: The weighted all-tree identity is proved by a disjoint classification of general-position sets. Finite checks replay from bundled standard-library source. Existing definitions, specific family formulas, and maximum cardinality results are credited to prior literature; originality and value are self-review assessments only.
scientific_limitations: The formula is for finite nonempty simple unweighted trees. It does not assert the same expression on cyclic graphs. Finite computational checks do not prove the infinite-family result, which has a separate combinatorial proof. Compact multivariate presentation is an arithmetic circuit, not a fully expanded exponential monomial list. Equivalent earlier results under alternative terminology cannot be ruled out.
title: An antichain expansion for general-position polynomials of all trees
